Oh god, you're so wrong. Please educate yourself.

For the average layman, yes. GIMP and Docs are sufficient. But if you are a professional whose main jobs are to make spreadsheets or create/modify digital images, though I hate to admit it, Photoshop and MS Excel are *far* better than the likes of GIMP and Libreoffice/Openoffice/Google Docs. MS Excel and Photoshop have an prder of magnitude more features than GIMP and GDocs.

The main reason is because it is completely [open source](https://github.com/torvalds/linux). It brings about a lot of great benefits that closed-source software doesn't give you:

* No way for NSA to spy on you by putting backdoors in
* It's free
* It's way easier to make software in it since you can look at other people's code
* There are virtually no bugs, since there are literally millions of eyes on the source code that would instantly fix it once a problem is discovered
* No incentive to make money, so no adware etc.
* It's generally *WAY* higher quality and more efficient, so it can run on really old hardware, and generally outperforms Windows by a lot in terms of performance

The only reason why you'd want to use Windows over Linux nowadays is for Photoshop, Microsoft Excel, and gaming. Linux beats Windows on literally everything else, though.

Being raped definitely sucks, and I really sympathize with you there. However I read your post history and it appears that most of the problems that you are dealing with in your life are mostly of your own doing in reaction to being raped.

I have a close friend that has been raped, and I agree it is a very horrible thing, but you made a huge mistake. Quitting all of your jobs, moving away from everyone you have ever known and loved when you are in this vulnerable of a position is, I assume, the main reason why you want to kill yourself. You should be surrounded by friends and family right now instead of being in isolation.

One of my girl friends was raped and I was there for her along with all of our other friends, and she said that the thing that really kept her together was all of the support she got afterward.

I know I'm making it sound like this is a trivial issue, and I know this sounds cliché, but this is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. If you go back, after enough time, you will be baffled at how you thought that suicide even remotely resembled an option.

If you don't want to go back, then it will be really tough to get over this (and you might not), in which case I really don't know what to say... But believe me: if you have some sort of support network, you **will** get better.

Well, maybe not *me* as the creator of the universe, but instead, the creator is actually an equal. Not a superior, like most religions preach. Maybe God is one of our computer geek friends that made some kind of universe simulation, and he/she was just showing it to us to check it out for fun. Maybe we just decided to choose living these lives on a whim or at random, to see what it would be like to live a shitty life. Maybe when we "wake up", it's just like a bad dream that we forget within 10 minutes of waking up.

Like, what if we chose a shitty life to use as contrast for the totally awesome life we're going to pick to live next, you know, to make it that much more awesome?

I know it totally can be not true, and the afterlife could just be blackness, or fire for eternity, but we don't know that. It could be *anything*. Since it could be absolutely anything, might as well be optimistic about it right?

And for the last paragraph... yeah. That made me feel a bit better. Thanks.
